question: 'Mother of Mohiniyattam' is a docu-fiction based on ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __Kalamandalam Kallyanikutty Amma.__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• "Mother of Mohiniyattam" is a docu-fiction based on the life and contributions of Kalamandalam Kallyanikutty Amma. 
 
• Kalamandalam Kallyanikutty Amma was a prominent figure in Mohiniyattam, a classical dance form of Kerala. 
 
• She is recognized as a key contributor to the revival and popularization of Mohiniyattam in the 20th century.
 
• Kallyanikutty Amma trained under renowned gurus and played a significant role in preserving and passing on the traditional techniques and repertoire of Mohiniyattam.
 
• Her efforts and dedication to the art form earned her the title **"Mother of Mohiniyattam."​**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Shovana Narayan:**

 
 
• Shovana Narayan is **an accomplished Kathak dancer** and** choreographer** from India.
 
• She is known for her **dynamic and expressive performances **in the classical dance form of **Kathak.**
 
• Narayan has received numerous accolades and awards for her contributions to Indian classical dance.
 
• She has also worked towards **promoting and preserving** the rich** cultural heritage of Kathak **through teaching and workshops.
